goals: Maintain the private Foundation resource pack for Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying its immutable source archive.
scope: Foundation v5 corrects only the modern item-model selectors for Veiled Leaves, Silver Birch Leaves, and Wisteria Leaves so their inventory previews reuse existing Foundation bushy geometry.

exclusions: originals/resourcepacks/Foundation v4.zip is immutable and is neither changed nor redistributed.
Block Geometry Extensions, BGE x Bushy Leaves, Mynx Trees Java code, Enderscape Integration Java code, and unrelated Foundation assets are outside this resource-pack correction.
No Minecraft test profile is inspected or changed.

dependencies.reason: Supplies every Foundation v4 resource retained by v5.
Defines the assets/<namespace>/items/<id>.json item-model selector convention used by the correction.

state.milestone: Foundation v5 adds three narrowly scoped Minecraft 26.2 item-model redirects to existing bushy leaf geometry; static archive validation passed and runtime testing remains outstanding.

current.summary: Makes Veiled, Silver Birch, and Wisteria Leaves use their existing Foundation bushy models in inventories.
